1.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
1.asv: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

2.web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
2.asv: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

3.web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
3.asv: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

4.web: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
4.asv: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

5.web: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
5.asv: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me and set me in a large place.

6.web: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
6.asv: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?

7.web: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
7.asv: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I seemy desireupon them that hate me.

8.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
8.asv: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.

9.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
9.asv: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.

10.web: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
10.asv: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

11.web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
11.asv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

12.web: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
12.asv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

13.web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
13.asv: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.

14.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
14.asv: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.

15.web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
15.asv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

16.web: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
16.asv: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

17.web: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
17.asv: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.

18.web: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
18.asv: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.

19.web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
19.asv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.

20.web: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
20.asv: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.

21.web: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
21.asv: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

22.web: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head of the corner.
22.asv: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.

23.web: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
23.asv: This is Jehovah’s doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

24.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
24.asv: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

25.web: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
25.asv: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.

26.web: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
26.asv: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.

27.web: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
27.asv: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

28.web: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
28.asv: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

29.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
29.asv: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
